throughput.name: 8 JIRLs x 10000 loop iterations
throughput.asm: la.local $r4, .Lloop; addi.d $r5, $r4, 4; addi.d $r6, $r4, 8; addi.d $r7, $r4, 12; addi.d $r8, $r4, 16; addi.d $r9, $r4, 20; addi.d $r10, $r4, 24; addi.d $r11, $r4, 28; .Lloop:; jirl $r0, $r4, 4; jirl $r0, $r5, 4; jirl $r0, $r6, 4; jirl $r0, $r7, 4; jirl $r0, $r8, 4; jirl $r0, $r9, 4; jirl $r0, $r10, 4; jirl $r0, $r11, 4; addi.d $r12, $r12, -1; bnez $r12, .Lloop
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 20 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r12, 10000' --asm 'la.local $r4, .Lloop; addi.d $r5, $r4, 4; addi.d $r6, $r4, 8; addi.d $r7, $r4, 12; addi.d $r8, $r4, 16; addi.d $r9, $r4, 20; addi.d $r10, $r4, 24; addi.d $r11, $r4, 28; .Lloop:; jirl $r0, $r4, 4; jirl $r0, $r5, 4; jirl $r0, $r6, 4; jirl $r0, $r7, 4; jirl $r0, $r8, 4; jirl $r0, $r9, 4; jirl $r0, $r10, 4; jirl $r0, $r11, 4; addi.d $r12, $r12, -1; bnez $r12, .Lloop'
throughput.notes: Eight static JIRLs are reused in a 10000-iteration loop, avoiding BTB capacity pressure. The loop without JIRLs takes 16823.79 cycles; the JIRL loop takes 119165.58 cycles, so marginal throughput is (119165.58-16823.79)/80000 = 1.28 CPI. Repeated runs on other cores give 1.28-1.66 CPI; the old 0.935 CPI was an artifact of subtracting a setup-only baseline whose instructions overlap with JIRLs.

notes: No destination data dependency; latency is not defined. JIRL is a taken indirect branch and does not sustain below 1 CPI on LA664. Throughput is measured with looped JIRLs to avoid BTB pressure; observed 1.28-1.66 CPI depending on core/frequency state.
